subject: maths
question: An ice cream cone is shaped like a cone having radius of 3.5 cm and a height of 12 cm. How much ice cream (in cm³) can it hold?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume of a cone = (1/3) × π × r² × h

Substitute r = 3.5 cm and h = 12 cm

Volume = (1/3) × (22/7) × 3.5 × 3.5 × 12

Volume = 22 × 0.5 × 3.5 × 4 = 11 × 14 = 154

**∴ The correct answer is 154 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of the cone (r) = 3.5 cm = 7/2 cm

Height of the cone (h) = 12 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of cone = (1/3)πr²h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dbce2c6bbe0fb6ffeacb42d6d6983eee2feea25a8b274261b6ba83a9861afa08.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume = (1/3) × (22/7) × (7/2) × (7/2) × 12

⇒ Volume = (1/3) × (22/7) × (49/4) × 12

⇒ Volume = (1/3) × 22 × (7/4) × 12

⇒ Volume = (22 × 7 × 12) ÷ (3 × 4)

⇒ Volume = (154 × 12) ÷ 12

⇒ Volume = 154 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 154 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Slant Height of Cone

The slant height (l) is the distance from the apex to any point on the base circle: l = √(r² + h²).

Surface Area of Cone

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = πrl and Total Surface Area (TSA) = πr(l + r).

Relation with Cylinder

The volume of a cone is exactly one-third the volume of a cylinder with the same radius and height: V꜀ₒₙₑ = (1/3) × V꜀yₗᵢₙdₑᵣ.</p
